message.name: LEARNING_1_TURN_1_N2_PART_1_TEXT
message.value: First, you must learn how to move around and get yourself a weapon. See the crate? There's a rifle in it. Come to the crate using

message.name: LEARNING_1_TURN_1_N2_PART_2_TEXT
message.value: buttons and take the weapon.

message.name: LEARNING_1_TURN_2_N1_PART_1_TEXT
message.value: Great! Now, shooting. If you don't know how to shoot, you'll be dead very fast. Aim with

message.name: LEARNING_1_TURN_2_N1_PART_2_TEXT
message.value: Aim straight at this marker.

message.name: LEARNING_1_TURN_3_TEXT
message.value: To shoot press SPACE.

message.name: LEARNING_1_TURN_4_TEXT
message.value: Holy sheep! Good shot! Nail down the success - try again.

message.name: LEARNING_2_TURN_1_PART_1_TEXT
message.value: What are you going to do when you get in such place? Jump! Go to the edge of platform.

message.name: LEARNING_2_TURN_1_PART_3_TEXT
message.value: Press the

message.name: LEARNING_2_TURN_1_PART_4_TEXT
message.value: button to jump forward.

message.name: LEARNING_2_TURN_2_TEXT
message.value: To get on the next platform, you should learn a special jump: Backflip. Turn your back to the wall and press

message.name: LEARNING_2_TURN_3_TEXT
message.value: Good. There's a shotgun in this crate, take it.

message.name: LEARNING_2_TURN_4_TEXT
message.value: And now let's watch your weapon in action. Jump to the next platform and destroy the target!

message.name: LEARNING_3_TURN_1_TEXT
message.value: The wind is the key to greatest shots. Depending on your skill, the wind can be your ally, but it also may become your foe.

message.name: LEARNING_3_TURN_2_TEXT
message.value: Here you can see the strength of wind and its direction.

message.name: LEARNING_3_TURN_3_PART1_TEXT
message.value: Lots of good weapons are affected by the wind. For example, bazooka.

message.name: LEARNING_3_TURN_3_PART2_TEXT
message.value: All your weapons are stored in the backpack. Click on this icon.

message.name: LEARNING_3_TURN_4_TEXT
message.value: Click on this icon to take the bazooka.

message.name: LEARNING_3_TURN_5_N1_PART_1_TEXT
message.value: To shoot the bazooka you should also adjust the power.

message.name: LEARNING_3_TURN_5_N1_PART_2_TEXT
message.value: Power is increasing by holding SPACE.

message.name: LEARNING_3_TURN_5_N2_TEXT
message.value: Here's your target! Take aim at the marker and shoot with maximum force. Press and hold SPACE.

message.name: LEARNING_3_TURN_6_N1_TEXT
message.value: Target dispatched. Great job! Let's try again!

message.name: LEARNING_3_TURN_7_TEXT
message.value: Great, let's go forth. Not all the weapons are affected by the wind. Look, there's a grenade in your backpack, take it.

message.name: LEARNING_3_TURN_9_TEXT
message.value: Now it's your turn - take aim and throw the grenade with maximum power.

message.name: LEARNING_MISSION_1_NAME
message.value: Training: Shooting

message.name: LEARNING_MISSION_2_NAME
message.value: Training: Jumping

message.name: LEARNING_MISSION_3_NAME
message.value: Training: Bazooka and grenade

message.name: LEARNING_MISSION_2_DESCR
message.value: Learn how to jump around the map.

message.name: LEARNING_MISSION_3_DESCR
message.value: Learn how to perform precise shots and use the wind.

message.name: LEARNING_4_TEXT_1
message.value: Now I'll show you a couple of tools to make your way through obstructions. First, pick up a crate with the DRILL.

message.name: LEARNING_4_TEXT_2
message.value: The drill allows you to make a long tunnel directly below. How does it work? Press the SPACE!

message.name: LEARNING_4_TEXT_3
message.value: So that's how it works. Let's try another tool: AUGER. Look for it in this crate!

message.name: LEARNING_4_TEXT_4
message.value: The auger torch is used to dig through any landmass. Come to this wall!

message.name: LEARNING_4_TEXT_5
message.value: Press SPACE to start digging! Your task is to pick up the next crate.

message.name: LEARNING_4_TEXT_6
message.value: Remember that both drill and auger torch can be stopped at any moment by pressing SPACE. But let's get back to your task, pick up the crate!

message.name: LEARNING_4_TEXT_8
message.value: Dynamite is laid under your unit's feet. Come to the target, press SPACE, and run away immediately!

message.name: LEARNING_5_TEXT_1
message.value: I guess it's quite boring to just destroy targets. Lets take a look at real enemies. We are going to use mines - basic and very useful weapon. Select the mine in your backpack.

message.name: LEARNING_5_TEXT_3
message.value: You can, for example, just drop a mine next to an enemy. But that will merely act like a weaker version of a dynamite.

message.name: LEARNING_5_TEXT_4
message.value: We'll do it another way. Come under the arrow, place a mine there (by pressing SPACE), and get to initial point!

message.name: LEARNING_5_TEXT_5
message.value: Run to initial point and grab the crate!

message.name: LEARNING_5_TEXT_6
message.value: Shoot down a zombie! By the power of a shot he'll be thrown on a mine, which deal additional damage!

message.name: LEARNING_5_TEXT_7
message.value: Finish zombie with your rifle if necessary!

message.name: LEARNING_5_TEXT_9
message.value: The second zombie is much stronger but we'll use a mine to send him to the water! Select the mine in the backpack.

message.name: LEARNING_5_TEXT_10
message.value: Place a mine at this point and run away to safety!

message.name: LEARNING_5_TEXT_11
message.value: Here comes a tricky part: you have to explode the mine without wasting a turn. Approach the mine, and as it starts beeping, get away!

message.name: LEARNING_5_TEXT_12
message.value: Great! Now you can take the crate with a weapon.

message.name: LEARNING_5_TEXT_13
message.value: That was close, you should react faster next time. Well, pick up the crate.

message.name: LEARNING_5_TEXT_14
message.value: So, you're wielding the BAT. I think you guess what to do. Stand next to the enemy and press SPACE.

message.name: LEARNING_MISSION_4_NAME
message.value: Training: Instruments

message.name: LEARNING_MISSION_5_NAME
message.value: Training: Landmines

message.name: LEARNING_MISSION_4_DESCR
message.value: Here you'll learn basic tools to overcome obstructions.

message.name: LEARNING_MISSION_5_DESCR
message.value: This mission will teach you to use mines.
